How to choose a bra

Balconette — open cups and a horizontal neckline, ideal under low-cut tops.

Push-up — padded cups that visually add volume.

Triangle — soft non-wired cups for the most natural silhouette.

Bandeau — strapless, for bare shoulders.

Bralette — lace, non-wired, can also be worn as a top.
